description: This file defines a React component for a rich text editor toolbar with formatting options, including heading levels, inline marks (bold, italic, underline, etc.), block inserts, and layout controls. It utilizes various UI components and icons, manages state through hooks, and interacts with the Slate editor for text transformations.

methods.name: Toolbar
methods.description: Main React component that renders the editor toolbar with formatting buttons, heading selector, block insertion menu, and layout controls.

methods.name: HeadingMenu
methods.description: Component for selecting heading levels or paragraph, updates editor blocks accordingly.

methods.name: InsertBlockMenu
methods.description: Dropdown menu for inserting component blocks into the editor.

methods.name: InlineMarks
methods.description: Component that provides toggle buttons for inline text formatting (bold, italic, underline, etc.).

methods.name: useMemoStringified
methods.description: Hook that memoizes a value based on its JSON stringification to optimize re-renders.
